text: Deadlines are a part of professional life, but they don't have to be stressful. The key is good time management, which means planning your work in advance rather than rushing at the last minute. Effective prioritization also helps; instead of trying to do everything at once, decide which tasks are most important and tackle those first. Another crucial element is scope management. If a project is growing too large, it’s okay to say no to extra requests or to suggest a simpler approach. Finally, never underestimate the power of communication. If you are falling behind, tell your team or client early; they will often appreciate the honesty and may offer support. By using these strategies, you can meet your deadlines with confidence and reduce your stress.
